## Getting Started

```{r echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
pacman::p_load(tmap, SpatialAcc, catchment, sf, 
               ggstatsplot, reshape2,
               tidyverse)
```

## Geospatial Data Wrangling

### Importing geospatial data

```{r echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
mpsz <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "MP14_SUBZONE_NO_SEA_PL")
hexagons <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "hexagons") 
eldercare <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "ELDERCARE") 
```

### Updating CRS information

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
mpsz <- st_transform(mpsz, 3414)
eldercare <- st_transform(eldercare, 3414)
hexagons <- st_transform(hexagons, 3414)
```

```{r echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
st_crs(mpsz)
```

### Cleaning and updating attribute fields of the geospatial data

```{r}
eldercare <- eldercare %>%
  select(fid, ADDRESSPOS) %>%
  mutate(capacity = 100)
```

```{r}
hexagons <- hexagons %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(demand = 100)
```

## Apsaital Data Handling and Wrangling

### Importing Distance Matrix

```{r message=FALSE}
ODMatrix <- read_csv("data/aspatial/OD_Matrix.csv", skip = 0)
```

### Tidying distance matrix

```{r}
distmat <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  spread(destination_id, total_cost)%>%
  select(c(-c('origin_id')))
```

```{r}
distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000)
```

## Calculate Catchment Ratio
```{r}
df_2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  max_cost = 5) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("2SFCA" = ".")
```

### Mapping 2SFCA
```{r}
mapex <- st_bbox(hexagons)
```

```{r}
hex_2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_2sfca)
tm_shape(hex_2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "2SFCA",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) + 
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("2SFCA Accessibility measures")+
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) + 
  tm_compass(type="8star", size=2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

### Enhanced 2-step Floating Catchment 
```{r}
step_weights <- list(c(5, .01), c(4, .05), c(3, .1), c(2, .4), c(1,1))
df_e2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  weight = step_weights) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("E2SFCA"=".")
```
### Kernel Density 2-step Floating Catchment Area
```{r}
df_kd2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  weight = "gaussian") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("KD2SFCA"=".")
```
### 3-step Floating Catchment Area
```{r}
df_3sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  step_weights,
  normalize_weight = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("3SFCA"=".")
```
